customManagers.description: The pin of the JS reference: the newest Mermaid release its commit contains, and the commit. A new mermaid@ release opens a pull request that moves both; its CI shows what is new (docs-port/ORACLE-PLAN.md).

packageRules.description: Only the crates are released. Updates of the harness and of CI are chores, not fixes that release-please would publish as a release of the crates (CONTRIBUTING.md).

One pull request per Mermaid minor release, opened without approval in the Dependency Dashboard so that a release is not missed, and merged by hand: moving the pin can need rebased patches and pending exceptions. The pin may sit a few commits after its release, so it gets no digest updates.
prBodyNotes: Moving the pin: run `tools/reference/setup.sh`, rebase or drop the patches that no longer apply, and fix every new difference or make it a pending exception with its issue (`tools/reference/README.md`).
